known.title: Search can expose cards after the searcher has left a circle

findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 2, Harm 4
Raise: Security. Case: normal use - a member searches while leaving a circle from another device, or while an admin removes them. The first query joins the searcher's membership but locks only the circle row. If the membership is deleted while this query waits for the circle lock, PostgreSQL can still read that membership from the query's earlier snapshot. The next query then reads current co-members without checking that the searcher is still a member, and the API can return their cards after the removal commits. [PostgreSQL documents that `FOR SHARE OF circle` leaves other joined tables unlocked.](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/18/sql-select.html) The race tests cover changes to the holder's membership, but not the searcher's.
